messages:
olivia_sales: Carl on the PoC call is seeing 403s on /v1/generate and 429s during a parallel load test. Error text: \"403 Forbidden: project claim mismatch\". Can infra triage?

carl_acme: Getting \"403: project claim does not match request\". Using key from portal and header X-Redwood-Project: Acme-Demo (note the capital A and D). Also saw spikes of 429 when we ramped 20 parallel streams.

olivia_sales: can you paste the curl you ran (mask the key)?

carl_acme: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk.poc.77xy\" -H \"X-Redwood-Project: Acme-Demo\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-large\",\"input\":\"test\"}'

maya_se: quick heads-up: project header is case-sensitive. Presales keys sometimes bind to a lowercase internal id like acme-poc-77. Also check scopes — the key may not have streaming/embeddings.

ben_infra: looking at auth logs: 
```
authz: key=sk.poc.77xy bound_project=acme-poc-77 tenant=acme-org scopes=[generate,stream]
request: header_project=Acme-Demo
decision: DENY (project mismatch)
```
So case mismatch + internal shadow project name. 429s are separate: your key is on presales/free throttle (90rpm) and we saw bursts to 400rpm during the parallel script.

henry_support: fastest fix: either call with X-Redwood-Project: acme-poc-77 (exact match) OR we can rebind the key to the friendly project name. For demos we can also issue a short-lived demo key scoped exactly to what you need and bump throttle for the window. Which do you prefer?

carl_acme: prefer rebind to avoid changing CI. Also we'd like a security note for our questionnaire: do you support customer KMS, how immediate is revocation on rotate, and can you provide audit entries for key changes?

ben_infra: we can rebind now. Security answers: hosted keys are encrypted with our HSM-backed KMS (AWS KMS) and we support customer KMS for Private deployments. Rotation revokes in the control plane immediately; edge caches historically had a short TTL (we've reduced presales TTL to 30s and will invalidate on rotate). Audit logs include create/rotate/rebind/revoke with actor, ts, and action id — we'll attach the export.

henry_support: performing rebind now (requires approval). Applying temporary uplift to 500rpm for 2 hours to avoid 429s during the demo.

audit_bot: Action recorded: rebind_rb_3301 by ben_infra at 2026-01-25T14:03:20Z. Quota uplift applied: 500rpm until 2026-01-25T16:03:20Z.

ben_infra: rebind complete. key=sk.poc.77xy now bound_project=acme-demo (friendly name) scopes=[generate,stream]. action_id=rebind_rb_3301.

carl_acme: re-testing now with original header (Acme-Demo) and calls succeed (200) with streaming. No more 429s during the demo. Thanks team.

olivia_sales: follow-ups: 1) I'll send Carl the audit export and the security blurb for the questionnaire, 2) sales to provide a pricing ballpark for sustained 10 qps (we typically estimate $7k-9k/month for redwood-large depending on token mix), 3) file portal UX work to display both internal project id and friendly name together.

maya_se: note for portal: show bound_project id on the key detail page to avoid case-sensitivity confusion.

olivia_sales: closing after I share the audit doc. :thumbsup:
